title: Ingestion Client v2 - Fast transcription config
description: Config for files uploaded to audio-input/fast/. Synchronous fast transcription.

locales.description: Candidate locales (e.g. en-US, el-GR). Empty [] = multilingual auto-detect. Two or more = language identification.

diarization.description: Separate speakers on a mono channel.

channels.description: Zero-based channel indices to transcribe separately (e.g. [0,1] for stereo). Not with diarization.

phraseList.description: Words/phrases to boost recognition (proper nouns, jargon).
